# Value

> Value constructor.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Value = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/value/ctor' );
```

#### Value( \[options] )

Returns a value instance.

```javascript
var value = new Value();
// returns <Value>
```

The constructor accepts the following `options`:

-   **band**: multiplication factor for the band width of a scale.
-   **color**: color value specifying per-channel references.
-   **exponent**: scale exponent modifier.
-   **field**: data field name or descriptor.
-   **mult**: scale multiplier modifier.
-   **offset**: scale additive offset.
-   **round**: boolean indicating whether to round a value after scale transformations.
-   **scale**: name of scale transform to apply or a field descriptor.
-   **signal**: signal name or expression.
-   **value**: constant value.

```javascript
var value = new Value({
    'field': 'price'
});
// returns <Value>

var v = value.field;
// returns 'price'
```

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-band"></a>

#### Value.prototype.band

Multiplication factor for the band width of a scale.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.band = 0.5;

// Get:
var v = value.band;
// returns 0.5
```

<a name="prop-color"></a>

#### Value.prototype.color

Color value specifying per-channel references.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.color = {
    'r': {
        'value': 255
    },
    'g': {
        'value': 0
    },
    'b': {
        'value': 0
    }
};

// Get:
var v = value.color;
// returns { 'r': { 'value': 255 }, 'g': { 'value': 0 }, 'b': { 'value': 0 } }
```

<a name="prop-exponent"></a>

#### Value.prototype.exponent

Scale exponent modifier.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.exponent = 2;

// Get:
var v = value.exponent;
// returns 2
```

<a name="prop-field"></a>

#### Value.prototype.field

Data field name or descriptor.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.field = 'price';

// Get:
var v = value.field;
// returns 'price'
```

<a name="prop-mult"></a>

#### Value.prototype.mult

Scale multiplier modifier.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.mult = 2;

// Get:
var v = value.mult;
// returns 2
```

<a name="prop-offset"></a>

#### Value.prototype.offset

Scale additive offset.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.offset = 5;

// Get:
var v = value.offset;
// returns 5
```

<a name="prop-round"></a>

#### Value.prototype.round

Boolean indicating whether to round a value after scale transformations.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.round = true;

// Get:
var v = value.round;
// returns true
```

<a name="prop-scale"></a>

#### Value.prototype.scale

Name of a scale transform to apply or a field descriptor.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.scale = 'xScale';

// Get:
var v = value.scale;
// returns 'xScale'
```

<a name="prop-signal"></a>

#### Value.prototype.signal

Signal name or expression.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.signal = 'width';

// Get:
var v = value.signal;
// returns 'width'
```

<a name="prop-value"></a>

#### Value.prototype.value

Constant value.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

// Set:
value.value = 5;

// Get:
var v = value.value;
// returns 5
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Value.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

var v = value.properties;
// returns [ 'band', 'color', 'exponent', 'field', 'mult', 'offset', 'round', 'scale', 'signal', 'value' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Value.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes a value instance to a JSON object.

```javascript
var value = new Value({
    'field': 'price'
});

var v = value.toJSON();
// returns { 'field': 'price' }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var value = new Value({
    'field': 'price'
});

var str = JSON.stringify( value );
// returns '{"field":"price"}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var value = new Value();

value.on( 'change', onChange );

value.field = 'price';

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```

</section>
